    • ENCODED_MDC

      public static final PatternRegistry.KeywordKey ENCODED_MDC
      RainbowGum's own percent-encoded (RFC 3986 URI query) MDC style, e.g. key1=value1&key2=value2 - unlike MDC, which matches Logback/Log4j2's %X output exactly.

    • THROWABLE

      public static final PatternRegistry.KeywordKey THROWABLE

    • EXTENDED_THROWABLE

      public static final PatternRegistry.KeywordKey EXTENDED_THROWABLE
      Extended throwable keywords. Same options as THROWABLE but also appends packaging data (jar/module and version) after each frame.

    • NO_EXCEPTION

      public static final PatternRegistry.KeywordKey NO_EXCEPTION
      No exception keywords. Renders nothing but, like THROWABLE and EXTENDED_THROWABLE, counts as the pattern having addressed exception rendering - suppressing the automatic exception formatter that is otherwise appended to any pattern that mentions none of these three keywords.

    • LOCAL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER

      public static final PatternRegistry.KeywordKey LOCAL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
      Local sequence number keywords. Unlike logback's %sn/ %sequenceNumber (which requires configuring a context-wide SequenceNumberGenerator, a feature not implemented here) this is a simple counter local to each compiled use of %lsn, starting at PatternConfig.sequenceNumberStart() and incrementing once per event formatted.
